nuggets.text: The Bulldogs debut an all-white alternate uniform in Saturday's home game against Western Kentucky.
It was 101 degrees at kickoff of the Bulldogs' season opener against Tennessee State.
Gunner Stockton completed 15 of 16 passes with three touchdowns in the Bulldogs' opener.
Nate Frazier needed only four carries to pile up 72 yards and three touchdowns in the opener.
Gunner Stockton is named after a great-grandfather, a World War II veteran whose nickname was Gunner.
The Bulldogs are the only school that buries its past mascots inside the football stadium.
Uga has a custom air-conditioned doghouse at Sanford Stadium, since bulldogs are prone to heat stroke.
In the 1890s, Georgia freshmen had to ring the chapel bell until midnight after wins; fans still ring it today.
Kirby Smart was a first-team All-SEC defensive back at Georgia with 13 career interceptions.
The Bulldogs' first team, in 1892, was organized by a chemistry professor, Dr. Charles Herty.
